gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: Selling the boat was a big mistake.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle expresses regret about a past action.

gaps.lead: Reporters expect the trial to last several weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Reporters expect it to last' becomes 'it is expected to last'.

gaps.lead: They cancelled the match because of the rain.
gaps.sentence: The match ___ because of the rain.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: Journalists allege that the mayor accepted bribes.
gaps.explanation: 'They allege that he did' becomes 'he is alleged to have done' — passive reporting.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action continuing from a past point to now: has been working (present perfect continuous).

gaps.lead: 'Don't touch the paintings in this room,' the guide warned us.
gaps.sentence: The guide warned ___ the paintings in that room.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with warned + object + not to + infinitive.
